Only 2 of 57 dropped here, so this screen is not a leak.
The three bullets are the canonical value proposition — the same wording should carry to the App Store listing and the paywall.

The one step from the live flow that stays. Units and bodyweight share a screen because a bodyweight figure is meaningless without a unit.
Bodyweight stays optional.

Programs, not one-off splits: a program implies a next session, and it seeds the Templates feature only 3 of 57 people ever found.
Replaces the import prompt as the terminal step, which lost 5 people and recorded zero skips.

OPEN QUESTION — not yet decided.
Option A: land on Home, with example data marked as an example on the surfaces that have nothing in them yet. All 21 non-starters saw an empty Home.

Not part of onboarding — this is what a finished first session returns, and where Apple Health is asked.
Kept here because it is the other half of the first-run experience.
